Hong Kong Island Coach Tour — Brief

Introduction

This invented introduction sits before the first section and is ignored.

Section 1 – Victoria Harbour

Star Ferry

The Star Ferry crosses the harbour between Central and Tsim Sha Tsui.

Clock Tower

The former railway clock tower stands beside the Cultural Centre.

Harbour View

An invented heading with no syllabus counterpart.

Section 2 – Central District

Statue Square

Statue Square sits in front of the former Supreme Court.

The Cenotaph

The Cenotaph commemorates the dead of the two world wars.

Section 3 – The Peak

Peak Tram

The Peak Tram climbs from Garden Road to Victoria Peak.
